## GET /v1/linktree/page - 1 credit (standard)

Returns data from a Linktree page including the user's display name, bio, avatar, and list of links with titles and URLs.

**Use when** you want it for linktr.ee pages; lnk.bio, Linkme, Komi, and Pillar pages each have their own endpoint.
**Cost** cache 900 s
**Paging** none

**Query params**

- `url` (required) - Full URL of the Linktree page · e.g. `https://linktr.ee/charlidamelio`

**Response** `Author` object at `data`, `{ author, computed }` ([full schema](schemas/Author.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `author.id` | Platform-specific user ID… |
| `author.username` | User handle or username |
| `author.avatar_url` | URL to profile picture |
| `author.bio` | Profile biography or description |
| `author.display_name` | Display name or full name |
| `computed.content_category` | Keyword-classified content category… |

+3 more (types in the full schema): `computed` {engagement_rate, estimated_reach, language}. Never filled: `author.followers`, `author.following`, `author.likes_count`, `author.posts_count`, `author.url`, `author.verified`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/linktree/page" \
  --data-urlencode "url=https://linktr.ee/charlidamelio" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```
